trainingobjetives.title: Training Objectives
trainingobjetives.remarks: Indicates the in tended outcome of the training and describes what the trainee will be able to do upon successful completion of the course.

subject.title: Subject
subject.remarks: The subject matter of the course.

lastcompdate.title: Last Completion Date
lastcompdate.remarks: The most recent date that this course was completed

description.title: Description
description.remarks: The description of the training course.

ownergroup.title: Owner Group
ownergroup.remarks: The group of people who are responsible for managing the course content

revisionby.title: Revised By
revisionby.remarks: The person who revised the regulation record.

siteid.title: Site
siteid.remarks: The site that is associated with the training course.

trainingnum.title: Course
trainingnum.remarks: The unique identifier of the training course

owner.title: Course Owner
owner.remarks: The group of people who are responsible for managing the course content

revisionnum.title: Revision
revisionnum.remarks: The revision number of the training course.Indicates how many times a training record has been revise

validityunits.title: Units
validityunits.remarks: Indicates the unit of measure for the Valid For field

certaward.title: Certificate Awarded On Completion
certaward.remarks: Indicates that a certificate is awarded on completion of the course.

courseduration.title: Course Duration
courseduration.remarks: The length of time that it takes to complete the course, measured in hours and minutes

trainprovider.title: Training Provider
trainprovider.remarks: The name of the company or third party who provides the training.

revisiondate.title: Revision Date
revisiondate.remarks: The date when the regulation record was revised.

trainmethod.title: Training Method
trainmethod.remarks: Indicates the method of delivering the course.Courses can be delivered in person or from a distance.

validity.title: Valid For
validity.remarks: Indicates the validity of the certificate that is awarded for successfully completing this course.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: The status of the training course
